opportunity_candidates.title: Agent Workflow Bottleneck Diagnosis
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Founder or operator whose AI-agent workflow feels slow, brittle, or hard to trust.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Agent workflows often fail at handoffs, memory, approval gates, and delivery proof.
opportunity_candidates.revenue_mechanism: Short diagnostic plus optional implementation support.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: AI Company Cockpit Setup Sprint
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Founder/operator who wants a local AI team cockpit and approval-gated operating loop.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Small teams lack a visible AI operating room for tasks, approvals, and commercial loops.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Install/setup advisory for a Labs-style local cockpit and task loop.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Coding-Agent Governance Audit
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Team using Codex/Claude Code/OpenClaw-like tools with code, secrets, or approval risk.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Teams want coding-agent speed without uncontrolled writes, secrets leakage, or unsafe deploy behavior.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Audit current coding-agent workflow and produce practical governance checklist.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Founder AI Workflow Audit & CEO Command Brief Sprint
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: AI startup founder or technical operator with urgent workflow and decision bottlenecks.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Founder needs a fast governed diagnostic of agent workflow risk, execution bottleneck, and next action plan.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Done-for-you workflow audit and CEO command brief.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Governance Template Paid Support
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Builder using open templates who needs customization and support.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Templates are useful but teams need help adapting them safely.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Paid support for governance templates and approval loops.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Internal AI Operations Audit for Small Teams
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Small team adopting AI tools across research, code, docs, and decisions.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Teams lack a safe operating protocol for internal AI work.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Internal AI workflow audit with low-risk improvement plan.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Open-Source-to-Paid-Support Package
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: Open artifacts need onboarding, configuration, and support to become useful.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Packaged templates plus paid support and implementation sessions.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.

opportunity_candidates.title: Y*Bridge Labs Runtime Setup Advisory
opportunity_candidates.customer_profile: Founder who wants to build a self-governed AI agent company runtime.
opportunity_candidates.problem_statement: The meta-development architecture is hard to design from scratch.
opportunity_candidates.proposed_value: Advisory sprint on local office, approval gates, commercial loops, and learning residuals.
opportunity_candidates.risk_boundary: Manual-send and owner approval only; no customer contact or external action by default.
